media.title: The Duchess Has a Twinkle in Her Eye — modern stage performance
media.description: Video of a modern stage performance of “The Duchess Has a Twinkle in Her Eye”. The uploader identifies Christoph Wagner-Trenkwitz with Ensemble Albero Verde in Die letzte Nacht at Theater und Kabarett “Die Hölle”, Theater an der Wien, and dates the production to 2014. This is not footage from Kind Lady (1935).
